tiers.text: Black's queen is close to your king. Can you give check so Black has no time to attack?
Look for a check that also lines your queen up with something else.
Your queen is the piece to use.
Qe5+ checks the king. Now your queen and Black's queen are on the same line, with only your bishop in between.
Your bishop is standing between your queen and Black's queen. What happens if it moves?
Move a piece out of the way and give check at the same time.
Your bishop is the piece to use.
Bd5+ is check, and it opens the line from your queen to Black's queen. Black has to deal with the check first.
Black had to answer your check. What did Black leave unprotected?
Grab the biggest piece you can reach.
Your queen is the piece to use.
Qxe1 wins Black's queen. Your bishop was a small price to pay.
